summary: SUP-1040 (Zenith Electronics Pvt Ltd) experienced a factory outage on 2026-12-02 due to clean-room contamination, halting production for an expected 96 hours. PO-1015 for 1200 units of ITM-540 (Bearing 540) due 2026-12-03 is affected, with exposure of INR 474384.00. Inventory at DC-PUNE holds only 150 units on-hand with 100 reserved, providing 0.5 days of coverage against 100 units daily demand, resulting in a shortage. The biggest unknown is when the supplier will actually restart production.
